name: Firefly
description: A personal finances manager that can help you save money.
composeYaml:
services:
  firefly:
    image: 'fireflyiii/core:latest'
    environment:
      - APP_KEY=${APPKEY}
      - DB_HOST=mysql
      - DB_PORT=3306
      - DB_CONNECTION=mysql
      - 'DB_DATABASE=${MYSQL_DATABASE:-firefly}'
      - DB_USERNAME=${MYSQL_USER}
      - DB_PASSWORD=${MYSQL_PASSWORD}
      - STATIC_CRON_TOKEN=${CRONTOKEN}
      - 'TRUSTED_PROXIES=*'
    volumes:
      - 'firefly-upload:/var/www/html/storage/upload'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:8080'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
    depends_on:
      mysql:
        condition: service_healthy
  mysql:
    image: 'mariadb:11'
    environment:
      - 'MYSQL_USER=${MYSQL_USER}'
      - 'MYSQL_PASSWORD=${MYSQL_PASSWORD}'
      - 'MYSQL_DATABASE=${MYSQL_DATABASE:-firefly}'
      - 'MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=${MYSQLROOT_PASSWORD}'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - mariadb-admin
        - ping
        - '-h'
        - 127.0.0.1
        - '-uroot'
        - '-p${MYSQLROOT_PASSWORD}'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
    volumes:
      - 'firefly-mysql-data:/var/lib/mysql'
  cron:
    image: alpine:latest
    entrypoint:
      - /entrypoint.sh
    volumes:
      -
        type: bind
        source: ./entrypoint.sh
        target: /entrypoint.sh
        content: "#!/bin/sh\n# Substitute the environment variable into the cron command\nCRON_COMMAND=\"0 3 * * * wget -qO- http://firefly:8080/api/v1/cron/${STATIC_CRON_TOKEN}\"\n# Add the cron command to the crontab\necho \"$CRON_COMMAND\" | crontab -\n# Start the cron daemon in the foreground with logging to stdout\ncrond -f -L /dev/stdout"
    environment:
      - STATIC_CRON_TOKEN=${CRONTOKEN}
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'ls /entrypoint.sh || exit 1'
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s
